name: Framing Summer
source:
Kou joins the camera circle since he wants to take pictures of shooting stars. He meets there Rui who loves taking pictures of everything, especially cute things. He summons up the courage to talk to her about his dream and soon new members join and they aim towards achieving this goal.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/08/01/august-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
航因为想拍摄流星而加入了摄影社。在那里，他遇见了喜欢拍摄一切事物、尤其钟爱可爱之物的瑠衣。他鼓起勇气向她讲述自己的梦想，不久又有新成员加入，众人一同朝实现这个目标迈进。

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/08/01/august-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
